bars: 8 of 11 board features work (5 directly on the local board copy, 3 via workaround, 3 unavailable)
3.9 min from session start (21:17:24Z) to first write pushed to origin/board-mirror (21:21:18Z) (vs 0 min on a local board)
body:
Antigravity on the web sits between a full computer runner and Claude Code on the web: it gives a real Linux virtual machine with headless browsers, Docker, and unrestricted GitHub pushes, so it can run code, full test suites, and UI checks cleanly. It cannot reach your local board, runs no hooks or usage tracking, and cannot message an external orchestrator, so it needs a short start and save sequence over the git copy of the board. Send it self-contained code, test, browser, and review steps that only need attached repositories; keep multi-repo orchestration, live board watching, and local secrets on your computer or Claude Code.

### 1. Reach (verified commands and outputs)
Antigravity on the web runs in an isolated NixOS-kernel Linux VM (`devbox`, 2 vCPU, 7,959 MB RAM + 8,191 MB swap, 85 GB free disk) with the connected GitHub repo pre-cloned at `/home/antigravity/anlonlt/board`.

- **Pre-cloned repo (single-branch):**
  - `git status` -> `On branch feat/streamline-doctor-memory` (clean).
  - `cat .git/config` -> `fetch = +refs/heads/feat/streamline-doctor-memory:refs/remotes/origin/feat/streamline-doctor-memory` (single-branch refspec; `origin/main`, `origin/board-mirror`, and `origin/kit-usage` are not fetched at startup).
- **Fresh GitHub clone & `gh` CLI:**
  - `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/anlonlt/board.git /tmp/r1-clone-test` -> `Cloning into '/tmp/r1-clone-test'...` (exit 0).
  - `gh api user --jq '{login: .login}'` -> `{"login":"anlonlt"}`.
  - Repo scope check: `gh repo view anlonlt/board --json nameWithOwner,isPrivate` -> `{"isPrivate":false,"nameWithOwner":"anlonlt/board"}`; `gh repo view anlonlt/harmonize --json nameWithOwner,isPrivate` -> `GraphQL: Resource not accessible by integration (repository)`.
- **Read `docs/prompts/`:**
  - Direct file read works immediately (`docs/prompts/r1-antigravity-on-the-web-how-far-it-runs-t.md`, `r2-...`, `r3-...`).
- **Read `board-mirror`:**
  - `git fetch origin board-mirror` -> updated `FETCH_HEAD` only (`fatal: Not a valid object name origin/board-mirror` due to single-branch refspec).
  - `git fetch origin +refs/heads/board-mirror:refs/remotes/origin/board-mirror` -> exit 0, created `origin/board-mirror` cleanly.
- **Run `python3` (and Node / Playwright / Docker):**
  - `python3 --version` -> `Python 3.12.16` (`python3 -I` works).
  - `node --version` -> `v22.23.5`; `node kit/board/test_page_layout.js` -> `0 failed` (Chromium/Playwright works headlessly out of the box).
  - `docker info` -> `docker daemon running`.
- **Commit, push, and delete a branch:**
  - `git checkout -b r1-probe-push && git commit --allow-empty -m "R1 reach test..." && git push -u origin r1-probe-push && git push origin --delete r1-probe-push` -> `[new branch] r1-probe-push -> r1-probe-push` then `- [deleted] r1-probe-push` (exit 0; no branch-name restriction).
  - `git -C ../board-board-mirror push origin HEAD:board-mirror` -> `36da48a..27f13c9 HEAD -> board-mirror` (exit 0).

### 2. The board
| Command / action | Verdict | Exact behavior observed |
|---|---|---|
| `python3 -I .kit/kit.py resume --role part --post r1-...` | **another way** | Fails out of the box (exit 4, `Connection refused` on `127.0.0.1:8765`, and single-branch clone lacks `origin/board-mirror`). Works cleanly (exit 0) right after `git fetch origin +refs/heads/board-mirror:refs/remotes/origin/board-mirror` (via CL44 git fallback) or after `web_takeover.py`. |
| `python3 -I .kit/web_takeover.py` | **yes** | Starts `board_server.py` on `127.0.0.1:8765` (survives across tool calls, `{"ok": true}`), creates `../board-board-mirror`, reconciles 84 posts and 162 comments from `origin/board-mirror`, and prints full resume. |
| `KIT_SESSION_ID=<id> python3 -I .kit/kit.py form <post> --doing "..."` | **yes** | Works against the local `board_server.py` (`post: in progress, yours`; writes `.kit/run/form/<post>.md`). |
| Write result to board (`board_cli.py` / `board-mirror`) | **another way** | `board_cli.py update` writes to local `board_server.py` (no Tailscale/LAN reach to owner's server; no Claude `ArtifactData` tool). `web_takeover.py save` refuses on this repo (`owns_board() == False` because `kit.artifact.prefix = "repos/board/"`). Plain `kit.py sync-db --commit` wrote 0 posts because mirror `db_seq` (322) matched local `MAX(seq)` (322). Workaround that succeeded: `kit.py sync-db --full --commit`, merge `origin/board-mirror` (`-X ours`), and `git -C ../board-board-mirror push origin HEAD:board-mirror` (`27f13c9` at `21:21:18Z`, 3.9 min from start). |
| Comment (`board_cli.py set comments`) | **yes** | `board_cli.py set comments r1-probe-001 ...` -> `{"id": "r1-probe-001", "version": 1}`; visible in `kit.py train runners --zoom R1` and carried to `origin/board-mirror` via `sync-db --full --commit` + push. |
| Tick a piece (`kit.py sub`) | **yes** | `python3 -I .kit/kit.py sub r1-antigravity-on-the-web-how-far-it-runs-t 1 --status done` -> `{"post": "r1-...", "done": 1, "of": 5}`. |
| `kit.py done <post>` | **another way** | Sends the form and validates all fields/subtasks locally (0 format errors), but refuses final `proof` on `anlonlt/board` for two reasons: (1) `attached_board()` demands Claude's `ArtifactData` push (`kit.py artifact push`), which does not exist here, and (2) `check_trunk_merged()` checks `origin/main` while the session cloned `feat/streamline-doctor-memory`. Without `proof`, `board_cli.py update ... '{"status":"complete"}'` is refused by `post_gate.py`. |
| Live activity line / `ArtifactData` / clerk replies | **no** | No hooks fire, `activity/` is never synced to `board-mirror`, no `ArtifactData` tool exists, and no external session messaging (`SendMessage` / `claude-code-remote`) exists. |

### 3. The rest of the kit
- **Hooks:** **no.** Neither `.claude/settings.json` nor `.agents/hooks.json` is executed by Antigravity on the web (`SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PreInvocation`, `PostInvocation`, `Stop` never ran; `.kit/run/` was empty before we ran `kit.py`). `.agents/mcp_config.json` (`board-kit` MCP) is not loaded either. What *does* auto-load from the repo: `AGENTS.md` (into `<user_rules>`) and `.agents/skills/` (`board`, `memory`).
- **The live line (`kit_activity.py`):** **no.** Never runs automatically. Even when invoked manually (`echo '...' | KIT_POST=... python3 -I .kit/hooks/kit_activity.py` -> exit 0, writes `activity/<post>` to local SQLite), `activity/` is excluded from `board-mirror` and there is no `ArtifactData` tool, so the owner never sees it.
- **The usage ledger row (`usage.py` / `kit_usage.py`):** **no (read-only).** `python3 -I .kit/usage.py --root . self --no-push` prints `usage self: no transcript for CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID here`. No `transcript.jsonl` exists on disk inside `/home/antigravity/.gemini/jetski/` (only `.system_generated/tasks/*.log` appeared when a background task ran), and no token-usage API is exposed inside the VM. Reading the existing ledger works after `git fetch origin +refs/heads/kit-usage:refs/remotes/origin/kit-usage` (`usage.py show` works).
- **Memory at edit time (`kit_memory_jit.py`):** **another way (manual only).** Never runs automatically on `replace_file_content` / `write_to_file`. Calling it manually via stdin works (`kit_memory_jit.py` returned K3 and K7 for `kit/board/board.template.html`), and `kit.py resume --role part` prints lessons for changed files.
- **Save point (`kit_wip.py`, `landing.py save`, `web_takeover.py save`):** **another way (manual only).** Automatic `kit_wip.py` and `Stop` hooks do not run. Manual `python3 -I .kit/landing.py save` works (`save: nothing (all of it is committed and on origin)`), and manual `git commit && git push` (code) + `kit.py sync-db --full --commit` + `git push origin HEAD:board-mirror` (board) persist everything cleanly.
- **Takeover by another platform:** **yes (for pushed work).** Because both feature branches and `board-mirror` push directly to GitHub, Claude Code CLI, Claude Code web, `agy` CLI, or another Antigravity web session can `git fetch origin`, check out the branch, and `kit.py reconcile` to continue seamlessly. Unpushed working-tree edits and the local `board.db` stay trapped in the paused VM until pushed.

### 4. Limits that matter for routing
- **VM resources:** 2 vCPU, 7,959 MB RAM (7,469 MB available, 8,191 MB swap), 85 GB free disk, no GPU (`device.py`: `holds 14 sessions, cores 2, GPUs: none found`). Full toolchain preinstalled: Python 3.12, Node 22, Go, Rust, Java, gcc/g++, Docker daemon, Google Chrome, Playwright (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit), Android/Flutter SDKs, `gh`, `sudo apt-get`.
- **Session length & usage limits:** Per-conversation VM persists across pauses and resumes; exact turn/time/token caps are governed by the owner's Google/Antigravity web plan and are not queryable from inside the VM.
- **Background execution:** Within a conversation, `run_command` supports background tasks (`WaitMsBeforeAsync`) and persistent daemons (`IsDaemon: true`), and `invoke_subagent` runs parallel subagents in the same workspace (`branch`/`share` worktrees unsupported). Outside an active turn, it **cannot** wake itself on a cron timer (`schedule`/`CronCreate` absent) or on external board events (`git_watch.py` does not wake a sleeping session without a user message), and cannot message external sessions.
- **Files, network, and secrets:**
  - *Can reach:* Connected GitHub repos (here `anlonlt/board` only; token in `/opt/antigravity/tokens` is proxy-exchanged for `github.com` and strictly repo-scoped), user-uploaded files (`/home/antigravity/upload/`), general outbound HTTPS (`example.com` HTTP 200), `google_search`, `google:browse`, `generate_image`.
  - *Cannot reach:* Owner's computer filesystem, owner's local `127.0.0.1:8765` board, Tailscale (`no tailscale`), owner's logged-in personal browser/cookies, local `.env`/keystores/private secrets, unattached GitHub repos (`anlonlt/harmonize` returned `Resource not accessible by integration`), Claude `ArtifactData`, or disconnected plugins (Google Workspace CLIs require connecting their plugin).
- **Cost:** Consumes the owner's Google/Antigravity web plan quota — **zero Anthropic/Claude tokens and zero local machine RAM/CPU**, making it a strong offload target when local RAM or Claude usage is tight. Exact per-session USD cost cannot be logged automatically because no transcript/token counts exist in the VM.

### 5. Profile and routing verdict
| Feature | Support | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Clone & read connected GitHub repo (`docs/prompts/`) | **yes** | Pre-cloned single-branch; fresh `git clone` and `gh` work |
| Read `board-mirror` | **another way** | Single-branch clone omits it; needs `git fetch origin +refs/heads/board-mirror:refs/remotes/origin/board-mirror` |
| Run Python 3 / Node / full test suites / Docker | **yes** | Python 3.12, Node 22, Docker daemon, 8 GB RAM, 85 GB disk |
| Headless browser / Playwright UI tests | **yes** | Chrome + Playwright Chromium/Firefox/WebKit; `test_page_layout.js` passed (`0 failed`) |
| Commit, push, and delete arbitrary git branches | **yes** | Tested `r1-probe-push` create/push/delete and direct `board-mirror` push |
| Reach unattached GitHub repos (`anlonlt/harmonize`) | **no** | Token strictly scoped to attached project repos |
| `kit.py resume --role part` | **another way** | Needs `origin/board-mirror` fetch or `web_takeover.py` first |
| Local `board_server.py` + `board_cli.py` + `kit.py form` / `sub` | **yes** | Started by `web_takeover.py`; survives across commands |
| Push board writes to owner's board | **another way** | `web_takeover.py save` blocked by `kit.artifact.prefix`; works via `kit.py sync-db --full --commit` + merge + `git push origin HEAD:board-mirror` |
| `kit.py done` gate (on Artifact-attached repo) | **another way** | Form send & local checks work; Artifact check blocks unless `board-mirror` is accepted |
| Claude `ArtifactData` MCP | **no** | Claude-only tool |
| Owner's local board (`127.0.0.1:8765` / Tailscale) | **no** | No Tailscale / LAN reach |
| Hooks (`.claude/settings.json`, `.agents/hooks.json`) | **no** | Zero hooks execute; `AGENTS.md` and `.agents/skills/` do auto-load |
| Live activity line (`kit_activity.py` to owner) | **no** | No hooks; `activity/` not in `board-mirror` |
| Usage ledger auto-row (`usage.py self`) | **no** | No local `transcript.jsonl`; can read `origin/kit-usage` after fetch |
| Memory JIT at edit time (`kit_memory_jit.py`) | **another way** | Manual invocation only (no edit hooks) |
| Save point (`landing.py save` / git push) | **another way** | Manual only (no `kit_wip.py` / `Stop` hook) |
| Takeover by another platform | **yes** | Pushed branches + `board-mirror` hand off cleanly |
| Background work / parallel subagents (within turn) | **yes** | `WaitMsBeforeAsync`, `IsDaemon`, `invoke_subagent` (shared workspace) |
| Autonomous cron / clerk / cross-session messaging | **no** | No cron tool, no external `send_message`, no unattended wake |
| Local secrets / owner's logged-in browser / GPU | **no** | Isolated cloud VM, no GPU |

**Verdict: In between (richer VM than Claude Code web, without CLI's local reach or either platform's hooks/messaging).**
Compared to the three reference profiles:
- **More capable than Claude Code on the web** on compute and git: unrestricted branch push/delete (including `board-mirror`), Docker daemon, preinstalled Chrome + Playwright (all 3 browser engines), `google_search` + `google:browse`, `generate_image`, and `sudo apt-get`.
- **Less integrated with the kit than both Claude Code CLI and Claude Code on the web:** zero hooks, zero MCP config loading, no local transcript for the usage ledger, no `ArtifactData`, and no cross-session orchestrator/clerk messaging.
- **Far beyond LMArena:** full GitHub read/write, full Linux shell, tests, and persistent VM.

**Which steps `antigravity-web` should get:**
- **Code (strong fit):** self-contained feature, refactor, or bug-fix parts on attached repos, especially heavy builds/tests/Docker jobs that save local RAM and Claude tokens.
- **Browser work (headless only — strong fit):** Playwright/Chromium layout, UX, speed tests (`test_page_layout.js`, `test_page_ux.js`, `test_page_speed.js`), and UI screenshots. **Not** steps needing the owner's logged-in browser, local apps, or Tailscale.
- **Research (strong fit):** web research (`google_search` / `google:browse`), codebase analysis, and benchmarking on non-sensitive repos (no local secrets).
- **Review (good fit, manual trigger):** independent code/test review of a pushed branch (`git fetch`, run `check` and `breaks`, write review post to `board-mirror`), though it cannot be auto-triggered or message the orchestrator back.
- **Never route here:** orchestrator, clerk, steps requiring local secrets/accounts/GPU/Tailscale, or steps requiring live Artifact-only updates without `board-mirror` reconciliation.

handoff: R3 can record `antigravity-web` as an "in between" cloud VM runner: full Linux (2 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, 85 GB disk, Docker, Chromium/Playwright, Node 22, Python 3.12), unrestricted GitHub push/delete on attached repos only (`anlonlt/harmonize` refused until attached), zero hooks/MCP/transcripts/ArtifactData/external messaging. task:
Find out how far Antigravity on the web runs the board kit, and which profile it fits: like the Claude Code CLI (a computer: git, the local board, hooks), like Claude Code on the web (a GitHub clone: the board's git copy, no local server), like LMArena (no GitHub: the board's shared link only), or in between. This step runs on that platform itself (runner `antigravity-web`): the owner starts it there with this prompt.

1. Reach: can it clone the repo from GitHub, read `docs/prompts/` and the board's git copy (branch board-mirror), run python3, commit and push a branch? Say what worked, with the command and its output.
2. The board: can it run `python3 -I .kit/kit.py resume --role part --post <this post>`; write its result into its post (board_cli, or a commit to board-mirror); comment; tick a piece (`kit.py sub`)? For each: works, works another way (which), or not at all.
3. The rest of the kit: hooks (does the platform run any?), the live line, the usage ledger row, the memory given at the moment a file is edited, a save point, a takeover by another platform from where it stopped.
4. Limits that matter for routing: session length and usage limits, whether it can run in the background, files and secrets it can or cannot reach, what it costs.
5. The profile: one table, feature by feature (yes / another way / no), and the verdict: CLI-like, web-like, LMArena-like or in between, and which kinds of steps it should get (research, code, browser work, review).

Bars: board features that work out of all tried; minutes from start to the first write that reached the board.
title: Antigravity on the web: how far it runs the board kit, and its profile
verdict: Antigravity on the web sits between Claude Code web and CLI: full Linux VM, headless browsers, and unrestricted GitHub pushes, but no hooks, no local board reach, no transcript ledger, and no cross-session messaging.
